cause_quote: The new recovery guard compared `buildModelCatalogRef(agentMeta.provider, agentMeta.model)` to the selected model and set `fallbackTransition.stateChanged = false` when they differed.
user_saw: After the session returned to the selected model, users could still see it marked as using a fallback and miss the recovery notice in chat history.
summary: The fix uses the admitted session model to determine whether a successful turn clears the fallback notice.
reasoning: Before #169773, accounting passed `sessionModel` to `resolveFallbackTransition` and persisted the cleared state when the session returned to its selected model. The commit added a second check that used response metadata, which can identify a different model when a tool-free finalizer produces the reply. That mismatch blocked the existing state clear and suppressed the new chat-history recovery notice.
